confidence_notes: The inspection observed no network API, so this script intentionally uses Playwright for the OutSystems/ASP.NET AJAX flow and BeautifulSoup for rendered HTML parsing.
Pagination was not tested during inspection; the script follows the observed .ListNavigation_Next selector and uses a best-effort content-change wait.
The exact semantic order of listing-table cells was inferred from the supplied sample-cell description; raw listing_cells is retained alongside mapped fields.
Detail fields are label-derived from the observed ShowRecord tables. Unobserved labels and alternate markup may not be captured.
Reviewer/contact, owner, responsible-person, phone, and email values are redacted conservatively; the findings specifically require masking those values.
The supplied sample date is future-dated relative to some execution environments and is preserved as site text without validation.

The mandatory product schema is adapted to accommodation listings: registration number or a deterministic URL hash is used as product_id, and no price is extracted because this site is not a retail product site.
